provider: eFax Corporate / Enterprise Fax Services API
method: Read the official vendor site and the linked public API reference through the browser. No API requests, sign-ins, contact forms or account creation were submitted.

authentication.token_request: POST /tokens, Basic authentication using app_id:API Key; application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8; grant_type=client_credentials
authentication.response: 200 with access_token, token_type bearer, expires_in (examples show number and string 86399), scope and jti
authentication.lifetime: Documentation states tokens expire after 24 hours and generating a new token immediately expires the current key.
authentication.adapter_boundary: Use an existing host-managed current bearer credential bound to the exact configured account. Do not mint a token for each fax or automatically rotate a shared application token. API-key-only setup is insufficient. Self-service token lifecycle is not established by the outbound adapter.

send.request: POST /faxes with Bearer Authorization, application/json, required user-id, optional transaction-id
send.acceptance: 201 array containing fax_id UUID and destination_fax_number per destination; accepted request is not successful transmission
send.number_evidence: Documentation recommends country-code format. The North American response example omits the leading 1; only exact validated +1 normalization is appropriate.
send.retry_boundary: transaction-id is documented as request tracking, not an idempotency key. No automatic replay of an unconfirmed send.

status.request: GET /faxes/{fax_id}/metadata with Bearer Authorization and the same required user-id
status.response: 200 object containing fax_id, direction, originating_fax_number, destination_fax_number, pages, completed_timestamp, fax_status, transmission_data and optional client_tracking_data
status.checks: Match the saved fax reference, outbound direction and destination; preserve unconfirmed status on malformed or conflicting evidence. An image storage state is not delivery proof.

implementation_scope: One reviewed PDF to one reviewed destination through the existing approval and vendor-work services. Outbound submission and status only; no inbox, receiving, deletion, cancellation, account provisioning or live verification.
